_note: The disasters pilot (v2 step 2): 24 named events, rebalanced for world coverage (Kevin, 2026-11-23). Picked by impact within each region and era, not by English fame. 'sub' is the type id in pipelines/common/disaster_classes.json; 'countries' are the Wikipedia articles of the places whose rows carry the event (resolved to QIDs); 'wide' marks an event that affects a whole region or the world (region row plus a global theme row). 'flag' is a call that goes to Kevin with the quotes. 'find' lists words a sentence of the article must contain to quote the date, for an article that covers more than the event.
